key_facts: The Space Force awarded three other transaction agreements worth a combined $615 million for the second task order of the SB-AMTI program.
Rocket Lab and STR are two of the three companies awarded; the third was not named due to operational security.
The new contracts build on a $4.16 billion deal given to SpaceX in May to develop an initial SB-AMTI satellite constellation.
Col. Ryan Frazier, acting portfolio acquisition executive for space-based sensing and targeting, said the awards ensure the service isn't locked into a single technical solution.
The Pentagon has called for a satellite network for airborne moving target indication because aircraft-based AMTI platforms are increasingly challenged by anti-access/area-denial capabilities.
